title: Continuity at both joins
statement:
A function equals $x^2$ for $x<1$, $mx+b$ for $1\le x\le3$, and $[$a]$ for $x>3$. Give the slope $m$ that makes the function continuous at both joins.

[__________]{a}
hints: The middle line must pass through $(1,1)$ and $(3,a)$.
Calculate the slope between those points.

feedback.message: Calculate the slope between those points.
